elements.name: row of large side windows along left wall
worn seat backs receding toward far end of bus
young passenger in nearest seat seen from behind and slightly to the side
backpack resting on empty seat beside him
steep forested Ethiopian highland slopes through windows

wrong_setting: The scenery is dense alpine conifer forest that reads as European or North American mountains, not the Ethiopian highlands. The interior is a short, tram-like compartment with a window on the end wall and only two benches, not a long country bus.
anatomy: The backpack is strapped to his back yet seems to pass through, or hang over, the seat back he leans against. His body sits sideways across a bench whose geometry is confused: he faces the left window while his legs run along the seat toward the right.
notes: Repaint as a long bus with a receding row of seat backs. Put the backpack off his shoulders onto the empty seat beside him and seat him normally, facing forward and turned toward the window. Replace the pine forest with Ethiopian highland slopes (eucalyptus, terraced green escarpments).
